box.name: Remove the obsolete Usage per wave output from kitchen-stats

outcome: In scripts/kitchen-stats.mjs remove the obsolete 'Usage per wave' section and the now-unused Usage parsing in readWaves, while preserving every verification figure, the wave attribution, all missing-data labels, the nonzero limit exits, and the exported helpers (readRuns, stallCheck, checkLimits) that scripts/verify.mjs reuses. Edit only the declared editable file.

submission.instructions: Edit only the files listed in box.json editable paths (src/scripts/kitchen-stats.mjs). It maps back to scripts/kitchen-stats.mjs in the owner repository. Seal the work with node box/submit.mjs and return submission.json.
